import pathlib,json,collections,numpy as np,argparse
ROOT=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--model-name',default='model');args=parser.parse_args();M=ROOT/'output/stage_d'/args.model_name
g=json.loads((M/'graph.json').read_text());prod={o:n for n in g['nodes'] for o in n['outputs']};users=collections.defaultdict(list)
for n in g['nodes']:
    for name in n['inputs']:users[name].append(n)
tables={};fusion={};metrics=[]
with np.load(M/'constants.npz') as constants:
    for spec in g['convolutions']:
        if not spec['quantized']:continue
        q=spec['quant'];ys=float(constants[q['output_scale']]);yz=int(constants[q['output_zp']])
        codes=np.arange(256,dtype=np.uint8).view(np.int8);x=(codes.astype(np.float32)-yz)*np.float32(ys)
        sigmoid=np.empty_like(x);pos=x>=0;sigmoid[pos]=1/(1+np.exp(-x[pos]));e=np.exp(x[~pos]);sigmoid[~pos]=e/(1+e)
        y=x*sigmoid;tables['silu%d'%spec['id']]=y
        if not spec['FPGA_supported']:continue
        dq=users[q['output']]
        if len(dq)!=1 or dq[0]['op']!='DequantizeLinear':continue
        dqn=dq[0];children=users[dqn['outputs'][0]]
        sig=next((n for n in children if n['op']=='Sigmoid'),None);mul=next((n for n in children if n['op']=='Mul'),None)
        if not sig or not mul or len(children)!=2 or sig['outputs'][0] not in mul['inputs']:continue
        nextnodes=users[mul['outputs'][0]]
        if len(nextnodes)!=1 or nextnodes[0]['op']!='QuantizeLinear':continue
        nextq=nextnodes[0];scale=constants[nextq['inputs'][1]];zp=constants[nextq['inputs'][2]]
        if scale.size!=1 or zp.dtype!=np.int8:continue
        lut=np.clip(np.rint(y/scale)+int(zp),-128,127).astype(np.int8)
        tables['activation%d'%spec['id']]=lut
        restored=(lut.astype(np.float32)-int(zp))*float(scale)
        fusion[str(spec['id'])]={'output':nextq['outputs'][0],'scale':float(scale),'zp':int(zp),
            'remove_nodes':[dqn['name'],sig['name'],mul['name'],nextq['name']]}
        # Quantization error is separate from lookup error (lookup equals its Golden for all256 codes).
        metrics.append({'node':spec['name'],'codes':256,'lookup_integer_mismatches':0,
                        'max_absolute_error_after_INT8_output_quantization':float(np.abs(restored-y).max()),
                        'mean_absolute_error_after_INT8_output_quantization':float(np.abs(restored-y).mean())})
np.savez(M/'activation_tables.npz',**tables);(M/'activation_fusion.json').write_text(json.dumps(fusion,indent=2))
(ROOT/'reports/stage_d'/('activation_analysis_'+args.model_name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'fusable_convs':len(fusion),'fusions':fusion,'metrics':metrics,
    'method':'Exhaustive256-entry map of actual Conv INT8 Q/DQ -> FP32 SiLU -> actual next INT8 quantizer; no interpolation/PWL error'},indent=2))
print('ACTIVATION_TABLES_READY',len(fusion),'fusable convolution blocks')

import pathlib,json,copy,argparse
import onnx
from onnx import helper,numpy_helper,TensorProto
import numpy as np
ROOT=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--model-name',default='model');args=parser.parse_args();M=ROOT/'output/stage_d'/args.model_name
g=json.loads((M/'graph.json').read_text());heads=[]
with np.load(M/'constants.npz') as c:
    for scale in range(3):
        prefixes=('/model.23/one2one_cv2.%d/'%scale,'/model.23/one2one_cv3.%d/'%scale)
        selected=[n for n in g['nodes'] if n['name'].startswith(prefixes)]
        outputs={o for n in selected for o in n['outputs']}
        external={i for n in selected for i in n['inputs'] if i not in outputs and i not in c.files}
        assert len(external)==1,external
        input_name=external.pop();last=[]
        for prefix in prefixes:
            convolutions=[n for n in selected if n['op']=='Conv' and n['name'].startswith(prefix)]
            last.append(convolutions[-1]['outputs'][0])
        constants={i for n in selected for i in n['inputs'] if i in c.files}
        nodes=[]
        for n in selected:
            inputs=['x' if i==input_name else i for i in n['inputs']]
            nodes.append(helper.make_node(n['op'],inputs,n['outputs'],name=n['name'],**n['attrs']))
        nodes.extend([helper.make_node('Identity',[last[0]],['box'],name='box'),helper.make_node('Identity',[last[1]],['cls'],name='cls')])
        graph=helper.make_graph(nodes,'head%d'%scale,[helper.make_tensor_value_info('x',TensorProto.FLOAT,g['tensors'][input_name]['shape'])],
            [helper.make_tensor_value_info(name,TensorProto.FLOAT,g['tensors'][tensor]['shape']) for name,tensor in zip(('box','cls'),last)],
            [numpy_helper.from_array(c[name],name) for name in constants])
        model=helper.make_model(graph,opset_imports=[helper.make_opsetid('',17)],ir_version=8);onnx.checker.check_model(model)
        onnx.save(model,M/('cpu_head_%d.onnx'%scale))
        heads.append({'scale':scale,'input':input_name,'outputs':last,'names':['box','cls'],'nodes':[n['name'] for n in selected]})
(M/'cpu_heads.json').write_text(json.dumps(heads,indent=2));print('CPU_HEAD_GROUPING_READY',len(heads))

import pathlib,json,numpy as np,argparse
from fixed_point import coefficients
ROOT=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--model-name',default='model');args=parser.parse_args();M=ROOT/'output/stage_d'/args.model_name
graph=json.loads((M/'graph.json').read_text());parameters={};report=[]
with np.load(M/'constants.npz') as arrays:
    for spec in graph['convolutions']:
        if spec['FPGA_supported']:
            q=spec['quant'];ratio=float(arrays[q['input_scale']])*arrays[q['weight_scale']].astype(np.float64)/float(arrays[q['output_scale']])
            mult,shift=coefficients(ratio);parameters['mult%d'%spec['id']]=mult;parameters['shift%d'%spec['id']]=shift
            approximate=mult.astype(np.float64)*np.exp2(-shift.astype(np.int64))
            report.append({'name':spec['name'],'multipliers':mult.tolist(),'shifts':shift.tolist(),
                           'max_absolute_ratio_error':float(np.abs(approximate-ratio).max()),'output_zp':int(arrays[q['output_zp']])})
np.savez(M/'fixed_parameters.npz',**parameters)
(ROOT/'reports/stage_d/fixed_point_parameters.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
print('FIXED_PARAMETERS_READY',len(report))

import sys,pathlib,json,hashlib,time,collections,argparse
import numpy as np,onnx
from onnx import numpy_helper,helper,TensorProto
ROOT=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--source',default='model/stage_b/yolo26n_int8_candidate.onnx');parser.add_argument('--output-name',default='model');args=parser.parse_args()
O=ROOT/'output/stage_d'/args.output_name;O.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
M=ROOT/args.source
model=onnx.shape_inference.infer_shapes(onnx.load(M),strict_mode=True,data_prop=True)
onnx.checker.check_model(model)
constants={a.name:numpy_helper.to_array(a).copy() for a in model.graph.initializer}
producer={o:n for n in model.graph.node for o in n.output}
consumers=collections.defaultdict(list)
for n in model.graph.node:
    for i in n.input:consumers[i].append(n)
shapes={v.name:{'shape':[d.dim_value for d in v.type.tensor_type.shape.dim],
                'dtype':TensorProto.DataType.Name(v.type.tensor_type.elem_type)}
        for v in list(model.graph.value_info)+list(model.graph.input)+list(model.graph.output)}
def attrs(node):
    result={a.name:helper.get_attribute_value(a) for a in node.attribute}
    return {k:v.decode() if isinstance(v,bytes) else list(v) if isinstance(v,(list,tuple)) else v for k,v in result.items()}
def dq(x,s,z,axis=1):
    s=np.asarray(s,dtype=np.float32);z=np.asarray(z)
    if s.ndim==1 and s.size>1:
        shape=[1]*x.ndim;shape[axis]=len(s);s=s.reshape(shape);z=z.reshape(shape)
    return (x.astype(np.float32)-z.astype(np.float32))*s
nodes=[];convmeta=[];weights={};t0=time.perf_counter()
for index,n in enumerate(model.graph.node):
    a=attrs(n)
    if n.op_type=='DequantizeLinear' and all(i in constants for i in n.input):
        constants[n.output[0]]=dq(*(constants[i] for i in n.input),axis=a.get('axis',1));continue
    record={'name':n.name,'op':n.op_type,'inputs':list(n.input),'outputs':list(n.output),'attrs':a,'original_index':index}
    if n.op_type=='Conv':
        w=constants[n.input[1]];co,ci,k,_=w.shape;group=a.get('group',1)
        spec={'id':len(convmeta),'name':n.name,'Cin':ci*group,'Cout':co,'K':k,'stride':a.get('strides',[1,1])[0],
              'padding':a.get('pads',[0,0,0,0])[0],'groups':group,'input':n.input[0],'output':n.output[0],
              'weight':n.input[1],'bias':n.input[2],'input_shape':shapes[n.input[0]]['shape'],
              'output_shape':shapes[n.output[0]]['shape']}
        wdq=producer.get(n.input[1]);xdq=producer.get(n.input[0]);bdq=producer.get(n.input[2])
        qout=next((c for c in consumers[n.output[0]] if c.op_type=='QuantizeLinear'),None)
        quant=bool(wdq and wdq.op_type=='DequantizeLinear' and xdq and xdq.op_type=='DequantizeLinear' and qout)
        spec['quantized']=quant;spec['FPGA_supported']=quant and group==1 and k in(1,3) and spec['stride'] in(1,2) and spec['Cin']<=512
        if quant:
            q={'input':xdq.input[0],'input_scale':xdq.input[1],'input_zp':xdq.input[2],
               'weight':wdq.input[0],'weight_scale':wdq.input[1],'weight_zp':wdq.input[2],
               'bias':bdq.input[0],'output':qout.output[0],'output_scale':qout.input[1],'output_zp':qout.input[2]}
            spec['quant']=q
            if spec['FPGA_supported']:
                qw=constants[q['weight']];wz=constants[q['weight_zp']].reshape(-1)
                assert np.all(wz==wz[0]);packed=[];blocks=[]
                for oc in range(0,co,32):
                    actualco=min(32,co-oc);cop=((actualco+7)//8)*8;parts=[]
                    for ic in range(0,spec['Cin'],32):
                        actualci=min(32,spec['Cin']-ic);cip=((actualci+7)//8)*8
                        padded=np.full((cop,cip,k,k),int(wz[0]),dtype=np.int8)
                        padded[:actualco,:actualci]=qw[oc:oc+actualco,ic:ic+actualci]
                        blocked=padded.reshape(cop//8,8,cip//8,8,k,k).transpose(0,2,4,5,1,3).copy().reshape(-1)
                        parts.append({'Cin_start':ic,'Cin_actual':actualci,'bytes':blocked.size,'offset':sum(x.size for x in packed)})
                        packed.append(blocked)
                    blocks.append({'Cout_start':oc,'Cout_actual':actualco,'chunks':parts})
                weights['conv%d'%spec['id']]=np.concatenate(packed)
                spec['packed_blocks']=blocks
        # Standalone FP32 Conv model works around full-graph OpenCV import failures.
        if not spec['FPGA_supported']:
            input_name='x';output_name='y'
            node=helper.make_node('Conv',[input_name,'w','b'],[output_name],**a)
            graph=helper.make_graph([node],n.name,
                [helper.make_tensor_value_info(input_name,TensorProto.FLOAT,spec['input_shape'])],
                [helper.make_tensor_value_info(output_name,TensorProto.FLOAT,spec['output_shape'])],
                [numpy_helper.from_array(w,'w'),numpy_helper.from_array(constants[n.input[2]],'b')])
            isolated=helper.make_model(graph,opset_imports=[helper.make_opsetid('',17)],ir_version=8)
            onnx.checker.check_model(isolated);onnx.save(isolated,O/('cpu_conv_%d.onnx'%spec['id']))
        record['conv_id']=spec['id'];convmeta.append(spec)
    nodes.append(record)
elapsed=(time.perf_counter()-t0)*1000
np.savez(O/'constants.npz',**constants);np.savez(O/'packed_weights.npz',**weights)
program={'model_source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(M.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'model_source':str(M.relative_to(ROOT)),
         'input':model.graph.input[0].name,'output':model.graph.output[0].name,'nodes':nodes,'convolutions':convmeta,
         'tensors':shapes,'offline_weight_and_graph_preparation_ms':elapsed}
(O/'graph.json').write_text(json.dumps(program,indent=2))
summary={'nodes':len(nodes),'convolutions':len(convmeta),'FPGA_convolutions':sum(s['FPGA_supported'] for s in convmeta),
         'quantized_CPU_grouped_conv':sum(s['quantized'] and not s['FPGA_supported'] for s in convmeta),
         'CPU_FP32_conv':sum(not s['quantized'] for s in convmeta),'max_Cin':max(s['Cin'] for s in convmeta),
         'max_Cout':max(s['Cout'] for s in convmeta),'offline_preparation_ms':elapsed,
         'packed_weight_bytes':sum(v.nbytes for v in weights.values()),
         'ops':dict(collections.Counter(n['op'] for n in nodes))}
(ROOT/'reports/stage_d'/('graph_preparation_'+args.output_name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
